decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to ramp up your mana quickly with cards like Elvish Mystic, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Llanowar Elves, in order to play powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to further increase your board presence and pressure your opponent. The inclusion of cards like Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God and Boseiju, Who Endures adds flexibility and resilience to the deck, making it a strong aggro-devotion deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and card draw to quickly fill up the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and then bring them back onto the battlefield for repeated attacks. The deck focuses on casting spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability, while also using cards like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle to refill the hand and continue the cycle. The inclusion of cards like Thing in the Ice and Chart a Course helps to further accelerate the deck's aggressive playstyle.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with green devotion cards and utilize various creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa help generate additional mana while cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns offer powerful effects on the battlefield. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure with efficient creatures and mana acceleration.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board using counterspells, removal, and card advantage to outlast and overpower opponents. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up its own resources, eventually closing out the game with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and threats like Shark Typhoon. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's control plan, with a focus on blue and white sources to ensure access to the deck's powerful spells.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on quickly filling up your graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenixes for aggressive and explosive plays. Utilizing efficient cantrips like Opt and Consider, along with powerful spells like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle, allows you to recur Arclight Phoenix multiple times in a turn. With additional control elements like Lightning Axe and Spell Pierce, you can disrupt your opponent's strategy while pressuring them with a relentless swarm of Phoenixes. This deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of spells and flying threats.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive elves. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling, the goal is to quickly build up a board presence and finish off the opponent with cards like Shaman of the Pack. The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to power out your threats. With a mix of card draw, mana ramp, and powerful elves, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver your opponent in a fast-paced aggro strategy.

This UW Control deck focuses on maintaining board control through counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes like Supreme Verdict. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria provides card advantage and control over the opponent's spells. The deck also includes lands that offer versatility and card selection, as well as win conditions like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up advantage and eventually securing a win with powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive threats to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption. It aims to control the board with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill, while utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa to deal damage and disrupt the opponent's resources. Additionally, cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser provide additional value and inevitability in the late game. The deck's mana base allows for consistent and smooth gameplay, enabling the player to execute their game plan effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage through card draw and recursion. Additionally, the deck utilizes a companion creature, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value by flickering permanents for extra advantage. The deck is designed to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and resource management.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing efficient removal spells and powerful creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger while removing threats with cards like Dreadbore and Fatal Push. The creatures in the deck are versatile, able to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes a mix of land destruction and card draw to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and utilize the combo of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards that help fill the graveyard, search for combo pieces, and protect the combo once it is assembled. Additionally, there are cards that provide additional value and flexibility, such as Can't Stay Away, Eldritch Evolution, and Esika's Chariot. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, leveraging the combo to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing spirits to quickly build up a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, combining the tempo elements of Azorius colors with aggressive plays. With a mix of efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, disruptive spells like Shacklegeist and Skyclave Apparition, and powerful tribal synergies like Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to control the game while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total. Collected Company allows for explosive turns and card advantage, while a versatile mana base enables flexibility in casting spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent with a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure on the opponent. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to quickly take control of the game and close it out before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while disrupting opponents with low-cost burn spells and counter magic. It also has some extra card draw to fuel its spell-happy gameplay. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher if the game goes long, and Galvanic Iteration allows for explosive turns by duplicating key spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a constant stream of threats and disruption to overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing the card Indomitable Creativity to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels onto the battlefield. By combining cards that manipulate the top of the library like Secrets of the Key and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to consistently hit high-impact creatures with Indomitable Creativity. Additionally, the deck includes ways to control the board with cards like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse and Shark Typhoon, ensuring that the combo can go off smoothly and protect itself from opposing threats.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of token generation, sacrificing creatures for value, and a potential explosive finish with Bolas's Citadel. The deck aims to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Gilded Goose and Mayhem Devil, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Priest of Forgotten Gods. The inclusion of Collected Company allows for additional creature advantage and versatility, while cards like Liliana, Heretical Healer and Woe Strider provide additional synergy and resilience. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan while ensuring consistency in casting key spells.
